html:
Jewelry Pricing Widget Cost

CaratBase offers free jewelry pricing widgets that let you display instant price estimates on your site. The widgets are easy to embed and cost nothing.

How the Jewelry Pricing Widget Works

  1. Go to /widgets.html and pick the widget you need (ring sizer, gold calculator, etc.).
  2. Copy the code snippet shown.
  3. Paste it into the page of your website where you want the widget to appear.
  4. The widget loads immediately and shows real‑time pricing based on CaratBase’s data model.

What You Get / Costs

  • Free to use on any number of pages.
  • The free widget includes a “Powered by CaratBase” line.
  • Widget Pro is available for $12/month per domain. It removes the “Powered by CaratBase” line and lets you add a custom call‑to‑action button.

FAQ

Do I need to create an account to use the widgets? No. The widgets run directly from CaratBase’s servers; you only need the code snippet.

Will my customers see the “Powered by CaratBase” line? Yes, if you use the free version. The pro version removes the line.

Can I customize the widget’s appearance? The free widget uses CaratBase’s default styling. The pro version lets you set a custom call‑to‑action button.

Get your free jewelry pricing widget now → /widgets.html
